summary: Design v49 binds the actual RunIntent source object to the approved v48 mainline without expanding scope: M7 initial-screen requires both frozen authorities before identity creation, bound intents use canonical V2 identity, and historical unbound non-M7 intents retain V1 compatibility. Failure is side-effect-free and all replay, fit, PIT, real-data, budget-mutation and final-OOS work remains forbidden.
